<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/ui-preferences"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the current user's interface preset (simple, balanced, advanced or custom), their per-area overrides, and their onboarding state (which onboarding steps they have seen, by version). A first-time GET returns defaults without writing a row; a row is only created once the user actually changes something via PUT. Users who registered more than a day ago and never finished onboarding are returned as having seen every core step, so they are never shown the first-run flow.
